name: First Visit Guide
texts: WALK IN, NO APPOINTMENTTAP YOUR CARD TO STARTWASH, RINSE & DRYTOWEL OFF & HEAD HOME
caption:
First time at Nebraska Dogwash? It's easy! 🛁
1️⃣ Walk in — no appointment  2️⃣ Tap your card  3️⃣ Wash, rinse & dry  4️⃣ Towel off & head home
$15 for 15 minutes at 3609 N 90th St, right next door to Nebraska Laundry.
